profiles.summary: The structural chassis of the full-suspension trail bike.
profiles.function: Locates the steering, drivetrain, suspension pivots, wheels and rider contact points while carrying riding and impact loads.
standards: frame size and geometry are model-specific
shock fit, pivot hardware and seatpost interfaces are frame-specific

profiles.summary: Front suspension and steering assembly.
profiles.function: Supports the front wheel, rotates with steering input and provides controlled suspension travel over terrain.
standards: wheel/axle format, steerer, travel and offset must suit the frame
air pressure, spring and damper setup are model-specific

profiles.summary: Spring-and-damper unit controlling rear suspension.
profiles.function: Supports rider/bike load through the rear suspension and controls compression and return motion as the linkage moves.
standards: eye-to-eye length, stroke and mounting hardware are frame-specific
pressure and damping ranges are shock-specific

profiles.summary: Pivoting structure that relates rear-wheel motion to shock motion.
profiles.function: Guides the rear wheel through the frame's suspension path and creates the leverage relationship acting on the rear shock.
standards: link geometry and pivot hardware are frame-specific
bearing sizes and torque values are frame-specific

profiles.summary: Steering bearing assembly between frame and fork.
profiles.function: Supports the fork steerer while allowing smooth rotation around the steering axis.
standards: bearing geometry and steerer/head-tube interfaces must match

profiles.summary: Wide flat/riser steering and control bar.
profiles.function: Gives steering leverage and supports grips, brake levers, shifter and dropper remote.
standards: clamp diameter, width and rise/sweep are bar/stem/rider specific

profiles.summary: Clamp connecting handlebar to fork steerer.
profiles.function: Transfers steering input from handlebar to fork and helps set cockpit reach and height.
standards: bar clamp and steerer clamp dimensions must match
fastener torque is stem-specific

profiles.summary: Left-hand contact surface on the handlebar.
profiles.function: Provides traction, cushioning and control between the rider's left hand and handlebar.
standards: inner diameter and lock-on/clamp design must match the handlebar

profiles.summary: Right-hand contact surface on the handlebar.
profiles.function: Provides traction, cushioning and control between the rider's right hand and handlebar.
standards: inner diameter and lock-on/clamp design must match the handlebar

profiles.summary: Left handlebar control for one hydraulic brake.
profiles.function: Converts hand input into hydraulic pressure or other brake actuation for its paired caliper.
standards: lever and caliper must use a compatible brake system and fluid specification

profiles.summary: Right handlebar control for one hydraulic brake.
profiles.function: Converts hand input into brake-system pressure/actuation for its paired caliper.
standards: lever and caliper must use a compatible brake system and fluid specification

profiles.summary: Handlebar control for the rear derailleur.
profiles.function: Sends indexed shift commands that move the rear derailleur across the cassette.
standards: shifter actuation and gear count must be compatible with derailleur/cassette

profiles.summary: Handlebar control for the dropper seatpost.
profiles.function: Releases or commands the dropper mechanism so saddle height can change while riding.
standards: remote actuation must match the dropper's cable, hydraulic or electronic system

profiles.summary: Front rotating wheel assembly.
profiles.function: Carries the front tire and rotor while rotating around the front hub and tracking terrain through the fork.
standards: wheel diameter, axle width/format and rotor interface must match the fork/brake system

profiles.summary: Rear rotating and driven wheel assembly.
profiles.function: Carries tire, rotor and cassette/freehub while transmitting drivetrain torque to the trail.
standards: wheel diameter, axle format, freehub and rotor interface must match the bike

profiles.summary: Front high-volume trail tire.
profiles.function: Creates the front contact patch for steering and braking while deforming around terrain.
standards: diameter and width must suit rim/frame/fork
pressure limits and tubeless compatibility are tire/rim-specific

profiles.summary: Rear high-volume trail tire.
profiles.function: Creates rear traction for drive and braking while absorbing small terrain features and impacts.
standards: diameter and width must suit rim/frame
pressure limits and tubeless compatibility are tire/rim-specific

profiles.summary: Structural hoop of the front wheel.
profiles.function: Supports the tire bead and distributes spoke loads while resisting trail impacts.
standards: diameter, internal width, bead design and pressure limits must suit the tire

profiles.summary: Structural hoop of the rear wheel.
profiles.function: Supports the rear tire and distributes spoke/impact loads in the driven wheel.
standards: diameter, internal width, bead design and pressure limits must suit the tire

profiles.summary: Bearing-supported center of the front wheel.
profiles.function: Allows wheel rotation around the axle and anchors spokes and brake rotor.
standards: axle spacing/diameter and rotor interface must match fork and brake

profiles.summary: Bearing and freehub center of the rear wheel.
profiles.function: Supports wheel rotation and houses the freehub mechanism carrying the cassette.
standards: axle spacing, freehub body and rotor interface must match surrounding parts

profiles.summary: Front disc-brake friction rotor.
profiles.function: Rotates with the front hub and is clamped by the caliper to create braking torque.
standards: mount type, diameter and thickness must be compatible with brake/fork setup

profiles.summary: Rear disc-brake friction rotor.
profiles.function: Rotates with the rear hub and provides the friction surface for the rear caliper.
standards: mount type, diameter and thickness must be compatible with brake/frame setup

profiles.summary: Front hydraulic disc-brake caliper.
profiles.function: Presses brake pads against the front rotor to create braking force.
standards: mount standard, rotor size/thickness and lever/fluid system must be compatible

profiles.summary: Rear hydraulic disc-brake caliper.
profiles.function: Presses pads against the rear rotor to create rear-wheel braking force.
standards: mount standard, rotor size/thickness and lever/fluid system must be compatible

profiles.summary: Single-ring MTB crank assembly.
profiles.function: Turns pedal force into chainring torque through the crank arms and spindle.
standards: spindle/bottom-bracket and chainring interface must be compatible

profiles.summary: Single front sprocket in the 1× drivetrain.
profiles.function: Engages the chain at the crank and defines the front tooth count for every gear ratio.
standards: mount/direct-mount pattern, chainline and chain compatibility must match drivetrain

profiles.summary: Bearing system supporting crank rotation in the frame.
profiles.function: Locates the crank spindle and allows it to rotate under pedaling and trail loads.
standards: frame shell and crank spindle standards must match

profiles.summary: Flexible link carrying drivetrain force.
profiles.function: Transfers motion from the single chainring to the selected cassette sprocket while passing through the rear derailleur.
standards: width/link design must match cassette and drivetrain generation

profiles.summary: Wide-range stack of rear sprockets.
profiles.function: Provides selectable rear tooth counts so a 1× drivetrain can cover a broad set of gear ratios.
standards: freehub body, sprocket count/range and chain/derailleur compatibility must match

profiles.summary: Rear shifting and chain-management mechanism.
profiles.function: Moves the chain across cassette sprockets and controls chain tension through changing gears and rough terrain.
standards: shifter actuation, cassette range, chain capacity and hanger/frame interface must match

profiles.summary: Seated rider contact point.
profiles.function: Supports the rider for seated pedaling and moves vertically with the dropper post.
standards: rail dimensions and dropper clamp must be compatible

profiles.summary: Telescoping seatpost for on-bike saddle-height changes.
profiles.function: Allows the rider to lower or raise the saddle using a handlebar remote, creating clearance for dynamic body movement.
standards: seatpost diameter, insertion depth, travel, saddle clamp and remote actuation must suit the frame/rider

profiles.summary: Left flat rider foot platform.
profiles.function: Transfers left-leg force into the crank while providing shoe grip and rotational bearing support.
standards: pedal thread must match crank; platform/pin setup is rider-specific

profiles.summary: Right flat rider foot platform.
profiles.function: Transfers right-leg force into the crank while providing shoe grip and rotational bearing support.
standards: pedal thread must match crank; platform/pin setup is rider-specific

profiles.summary: Removable axle securing the front hub in the fork.
profiles.function: Passes through fork and hub to locate and clamp the front wheel.
standards: diameter, length and thread must match fork/hub

profiles.summary: Removable axle securing the rear hub in the frame.
profiles.function: Passes through frame and hub to locate and clamp the rear wheel.
standards: diameter, length and thread must match frame/hub
